Authorisation for disposal and declaration form Auctioneer use only Queensland Government Complete this form when you have an asset to be sold at auction. You will need to complete both sections of this form: - Authorisation for disposal - Declaration of data and physical security. Please submit this form to your preferred authorised government auctioneer. A list of auctioneers is available at www.hpw.qld.gov.au/disposals. If you require any assistance completing this form, please contact the Queensland Government Chief Procurement Office (QGCPO) on (07) 3224 7943 or disposals@9gspo.qld.gov.au. Special terms Section 1 - Authorisation for disposal Payment details Where proceeds from the sale will be forwarded to. List Either enter the items to be disposed of on this form, or attach your own list with the same headings. Declaring authorities are responsible for ensuring that all goods are received either by the transport company or the auction centre. Condition code abbreviations For example, E3 means used or reconditioned, in a fair condition. - Excellent - Good - Fair - Poor N: New E: Used / reconditioned O: Used / useable without repairs R: Used / repairs required UR: Unrepairable
